data.long_meaning: A variation of the name Mary, which means 'rebellion' or 'bitter'. In this form, Marje means 'Mary's jewel' or 'rebel gem'. The name Marje carries the meaning “Mary's jewel” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Marje usually hope their child will grow to embody mary's jewel and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: Marje carries the spiritual significance of the name Mary, representing purity, motherhood, deep faith, and strength.
